name: zclass_gwnode_update_subtree
description: gwNode::UpdateSubtree recursively updates active queued children, updates the current node, and marks it pending removal from the queued-tree bucket.
known_limits: tier S comparison is deferred to a coherent zClass tree-update/source-cluster pass; local VC5SP3 coverage currently records compile-only source compatibility for UpdateSubtree.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44eb00 validates iterating node->listB, recursively calling gwNode::UpdateSubtree only for children with flag bit 0 set, then calling zClass_Class::gwNodeUpdate(node), zClass_TypeList::MarkPendingRemoval(7, node), and returning zero.

The native gwNode tree smoke verifies active child recursion through UpdateSubtree, inactive child skipping, clearing the transform-queued flag through gwNodeUpdate, and queued-tree pending-removal marks for the updated nodes.
